newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-WORLD SHOT PUT CHAMPION BAGACH FAILS DRUG TEST.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-WORLD SHOT PUT CHAMPION BAGACH FAILS DRUG TEST.

text.p: Ukraine's world shot put champion Aleksandr Bagach has tested positive for a stimulant and been stripped of his gold medal, athletics sources said on Thursday.
Bagach, who was caught cheating with drugs in 1989, will be given a public warning and lose his $60,000 winner's prize money.
The sources said the International Amateur Athletic Federation would make an official announcement later on Thursday.
Bagach, the bronze medallist at last year's Atlanta Olympics, tested positive for the male hormone testosterone at the European Cup in Gateshead, England in 1989 while competing for the Soviet Union.
He was banned for two years.
The 30-year-old equalled his personal best by recording 21.47 metres at his third attempt to win the gold medal here on Saturday.
